about: Parking places for index.html and back.html. Coordinates are local metres (x east, z south). car/moto: y = confirmed by the evidence listed, ? = not confirmed, n = not for parking. Evidence was read by a person on 2026-11-04 from Esri World Imagery (captures 2025-01-19 and 2026-03-05), Google Street View (dates in the text), Google Maps listings and the campus map's existing data. Nothing here is a survey; vehicle counts drawn on the map are illustrative.
